## Agent Organization Manager v0.1.2

- Rewrote and expanded SKILL.md with detailed real-world cases, concrete step-by-step guidance, and best practices for agent-driven organizations
- Added practical templates for rosters, department boundaries, communication protocols, audit procedures, and release management
- Clarified anti-patterns, upgrade routines, and agent autonomy ladder for progressive adoption
- Removed outdated skill-card.md file for clarity
- All instructions and case studies now grounded in real implementation experience and operational incidents

- Removed sample documentation file: skill-card.md.
- No changes to core functionality.
- No updates to the main documentation or configuration.

Initial release: Establishes a robust framework for organizing AI agents into a multi-department company structure.

- Sets up departmental hierarchy, roles, and a central CEO agent for orchestration.
- Defines communication protocols (real-time, async, alerts, broadcasts) with detailed routing rules.
- Introduces daily reporting and learning cycles for each department using cron automation.
- Implements an inspection/audit system for operational accountability.
- Provides best practices and anti-pattern warnings for cross-agent communication.
- Offers a clear file and directory structure for organization and scalability.
